choices: Faster clients slow down over time
A slow client occupies the shared medium far longer to move the same data, and during that time nobody else can transmit — so the slowest client degrades everyone
Beacon frames consume most of the airtime
explanation: A legacy device at 6 Mb/s takes a hundred times the airtime of a modern one at 600 Mb/s for the same bytes. This is why disabling low data rates is standard practice in dense deployments.
